title: AI Automation Engineer
note: Requirements are weighted so scoring can be decomposed and explained. Weights are a starting point and are expected to change once ranking agreement is measured against a human shortlist.

requirements.label: Relevant experience
requirements.note: Scored on a curve; 0 years is not disqualifying for a junior-mid opening.

exclusion_rationale: Identity and contact fields carry demographic signal and are irrelevant to competence. Institution is excluded to avoid prestige bias. Languages are excluded here because the role is English-only; a role with a genuine language requirement would score it explicitly rather than implicitly.
